sections.summary: Standard engineering drawings require Third-Angle projection views: Front View, Top View, Right Side View, Isometric 3D View, and Detail Section A-A. All views must maintain true scale alignment.

GD&T specifies exact allowable variations in geometry rather than simple plus-minus linear tolerance. Includes Datum references (A: primary mounting plane, B: central bore axis, C: indexing pin hole).

controls.position: True position tolerance circle relative to datums A, B, C
controls.flatness: Allowable surface deviation between two parallel planes
controls.concentricity: Coaxiality of revolving motor and gearbox shafts
controls.perpendicularity: Squareness of structural columns to mounting flange

sections.topic: Exportable Vector Blueprint Format Specification (DXF / SVG)
sections.summary: Defines deterministic schema for exporting CAD vector blueprints with SVG paths, dimension lines, extension lines, arrowheads, datum indicators, and standard ASME title block.
